questions.stemHtml: A 45-year-old female patient presents to the hospital with complaints of abdominal pain and distension. She reports that she has been experiencing these symptoms for the past few months, but they have recently become more severe. On examination, her abdomen is distended, and a palpable mass is felt in the right upper quadrant. Her laboratory investigations show an elevated eosinophil count. USG is shown here. What is the most likely diagnosis?
